notes.title: 【UPDATE NOTICE】
notes.content:
We will perform an update on next Monday, 2018/07/02. 
The update is expected to last up to a maximum of 5 hours.

Start time: 06:00 UTC, 2018/07/02
End time: 11:00 UTC, 2018/07/02

Update contents: 
1. A new weekly event: "Tier Competition" is online. It provides great rewards including new rare items!
2. New rare item: Booster, which can accelerate rooms and technology upgrading!
3. New rare item: Experience Book, which can be used to quickly upgrade a target staff member!

Please leave game in advance to avoid data loss, thank you!
